_note: DECIDED by the team (Nov 14 2026): the six scores are final. The six scores, their weights, the priority boosts and the grade cut-offs live ONLY here. The plan (docs/fieldshift-v2.md) does not name the six scores; these names came from the team on Nov 14 2026. Change a name, weight or cut-off here and nothing else needs to change (the contract refers to scores by `id`; the app shows `nameKey` from i18n).
scoreScale: 0-100, higher is better, for every score

scores.measures: Median return above variable costs, per acre per year, over the simulated seasons
Result in the worst 10% of seasons compared with the current rotation
Erosion vs soil loss tolerance T, bare days per year, organic matter trend
Water left for the next crop and water stress
Nitrogen balance and fertilizer bought (legume credit)
Shared hosts, green bridges, crop family repeats

priorities._note: The farmer's priorities from the plan (income, soil, low risk, save water). A priority multiplies the weight of the scores it lists; weights are then re-scaled to add up to 1.

grades._note: Weighted total (0-100) to letter grade. Lowest cut-off first match from the top.
